rules.statement: Section 67 of the Partition Act does not render void dealings with a portion of land excluded from a partition action on the ground that it is a separate land.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would hold for these reasons that where a particular portion of land is excluded from a partition on the ground that some person or persons have title to it as a separate land, s. 67 does not render void dealings with that portion during the pendency of that action."
